items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I got turned on to Dave Brubeck... I listened to Brubeck... You got a nice quote from Dave Brubeck.

ctx.x: And yeah, it’s an interesting ride. The whole thing that got me into this, along with the music, because I’m not old enough to have been there when it was really happening. I might have been on the planet in the 1950s, but I wasn’t making any clubs. But I was a fan of this music, I still am a fan of the music. I got lucky and took some guitar lessons as a very young kid and my instructors were jazz aficionados, jazz players. So my father played classical music around the house.
